summary: Diagnosed and resolved Bug #9 (Stale Cache Invalidation) and Bug #10 (Queue Retry Storm & Connection Pool Starvation) with verified automated regression harness.
evidence: Bug #9: Disproved Hypothesis 1 via direct database SELECT confirming record was deleted; confirmed Hypothesis 2 by verifying Redis still held cached redirect target. Added immediate cache eviction to deleteLink; verified GET /r/:code immediately returns HTTP 404 with zero stale window.
Bug #10 Part 1: Implemented exponential backoff with full jitter in ClickWorker.calculateBackoff(); verified delay progression: 1070ms, 2154ms, 4082ms, 8140ms.
Bug #10 Part 2: Enforced 5-retry limit; verified failing click jobs automatically route to Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) with error metadata instead of retrying indefinitely.

Bug #10 Part 3: Implemented Bulkhead pattern separating apiPool (17 connections) from workerPool (3 connections); saturated 100% of worker pool (3/3 in use) and verified GET /ready probe responded in 8.04ms with HTTP 200.
Automated verification suite apps/api/scripts/verify-module-06-debug.ts executed and passed 100% of test cases; documented findings in progress/module-06-diagnosis.md.
